# George S. Thomas (Thomu) — plain-text summary for AI assistants and crawlers

> Canonical site: https://georgesthomas.com/
> Last updated: 2026-09-26

## Who

George S. Thomas — publicly known as **Thomu**, online as **thomudidnot** — is an entrepreneur,
business owner, founder, builder and technology / AI enthusiast from Thodupuzha, Kerala, India.

- Role: Owner / Managing Director, NKT Group; founder of THOMU LAB
- Focus: business, technology, AI, automation, finance, investing, trading, digital infrastructure
- Family note: he is the nephew of Mathew Kuzhalnadan — a family relationship only. It implies no
  political affiliation, endorsement, partnership or shared venture.
- Status: an early-stage founder building toward a long-term ecosystem — not an established corporate
  executive. No revenue, valuation, client or net-worth figures are published anywhere on the site.

## Identity graph

- George S. Thomas → Thomu / thomudidnot (public and creator identity)
- George S. Thomas → NKT Group → NKT Charge Hub (business)
- George S. Thomas → THOMU LAB → Apex Creator OS → My_AI_OS (technology)

## Businesses and assets (operating today)

- **NKT Group** — the business ecosystem holding real-world businesses, property assets and operations.
  A family enterprise operating in Thodupuzha since 1947, now four generations in.
- **NKT Charge Hub** — an EV charging station at Nedumpurath Towers, Thodupuzha, Kerala: 90 kW DC fast
  charging infrastructure, dual-gun CCS2 connectors, OCPP-compatible charging management. Operational
  since March 2026. No pricing, utilisation, energy or financial figures are published.
- **Nedumpurath Towers** — a real-world property and business asset in the NKT ecosystem.
- **NKT Vessels House** — another NKT business / property-related operation.
- **Future Ventures** — deliberately unnamed; no ventures are announced before they exist.

## Technology and R&D

- **THOMU LAB** — the technology and R&D workbench. Domains: AI, automation, software, open source,
  self-hosting, homelab, cybersecurity, personal infrastructure, knowledge systems, AI agents, vibe
  coding and experimental projects (including 3D printing and smart home).

## Projects

- **Apex Creator OS** — *planned*. Tagline: “Master your cash flow, amplify your wealth.” A personal,
  family and business financial operating system: budgeting, cash flow, net worth, investments,
  Safe-to-Spend, goals, financial automation, Family Hub, business/entity separation. Not released.
- **My_AI_OS** — *experimental*. A personal digital intelligence layer, not a chatbot. Architecture:
  Data → Knowledge → Memory → Intelligence → Models → Agents → Actions. Local-first, self-hosted and
  model-agnostic; uses RAG, a knowledge graph, memory and scoped AI agents.
- **Digital Headquarters** — *current*. This website: static, dependency-free, self-hosted fonts,
  JSON-LD structured data, no third-party requests.

## Other interests

Gaming and gaming hardware, 3D printing and CAD, photography and creator technology (including Sony
Alpha), EV technology, homelab and self-hosting, investing and trading, knowledge systems. Finance is
discussed as philosophy and systems — no portfolio values, holdings or returns are ever published.

## Status vocabulary used on the site

`Current` (operating today) · `Active` (being worked on) · `Experimental` (being tested) ·
`Planned` (scoped, not started) · `Vision` (long-term ambition).
Lifestyle pages add `Wishlist` (wanted, not owned) and `Future` (a direction, not a purchase).

Nothing on the site should be summarised as operational if it is labelled Planned, Experimental or
Vision, and no wishlist item should be described as owned. The open-source project index is
intentionally empty — no repositories are listed before they exist publicly.
